# roots documentation map

> Machine-readable index of the project's documentation: the root README and
> AGENTS rulebook plus every doc under docs/. Generated by `pnpm docs:gen`
> (scripts/docs/gen-llms.mts) — never hand-edit. Paths are repo-relative; fetch
> them directly (private-repo code search is unreliable, exact paths are not).

## Overview

- [roots](README.md): Rapid Opinionated Onboarding — TypeScript. A GitHub template that seeds an AI-agent-ready pnpm + Turborepo monorepo.

## Rulebook

- [roots agent rulebook](AGENTS.md): Rapid Opinionated Onboarding — TypeScript. A template repository that seeds AI-agent-ready pnpm + Turborepo monorepos with a specs-and-decisions docs system.

- [Capability or entity name](docs/internal/specs/_template.md): One paragraph: what this capability or entity is for and who depends on it.
